name: Heart of Obsidion
summary: The Heart of Obsidion is proof Thorius needs from Searing Gorge. It bears on the danger that still grips these lands.

sections.title: A Heart Returned
sections.body: Thorius in Ironforge asks for the Heart of Obsidion after a warning from Dorius. The heart, taken from Obsidion in Searing Gorge, is brought back with the Head of Lathoric the Black. Thorius must see both before he can believe what has happened.

sections.title: Thorius's Grief
sections.body: When Thorius sees the Heart of Obsidion and Lathoric's head, his face turns white. He learns his own brother set the trap and betrayed Ironforge. Thorius fears the Old Gods' influence remains strong in these lands, and that Ragnaros could turn even the noble and honorable.

faq.q: What is the Heart of Obsidion?
faq.answer: The Heart of Obsidion is a trophy taken from Obsidion in Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Who needs the Heart of Obsidion?
faq.answer: Thorius in Ironforge asks for the Heart of Obsidion alongside the Head of Lathoric the Black.

faq.q: Why does Thorius want the heart?
faq.answer: Thorius refuses to believe what he hears until he sees proof: the Heart of Obsidion and the Head of Lathoric the Black.
Together with Lathoric's head, the heart shows Thorius that the warning about a trap was true.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Thorius's errand cuts close: a dying dwarven archaeologist in Searing Gorge begs you to strike back for Thorius.
